messages:
jena_csm: Quick sync for Orbit Labs dedicated bring-up. Need: final quota commit, autoscale packing, and two staged load tests next week. Can someone own quota mapping?
oliver_se: I can. They asked for 700k tokens/day guaranteed, burst to 1.6M for 3h. Recommend commit=725k tokens/day + burst_bucket with token_rate=900 rps, bucket_size=45k. Will post YAML.
hannah_sre: Autoscale defaults: min_replicas=1, max_replicas=10, target_gpu_util=68%. Suggest pack_policy=binpack to maximize utilization. Add warmup_grace=8m to absorb cold-cache.
mike_ops: Proposed test cadence: dry-run Fri 14:00 local (20% traffic), smoke Mon 09:00 (50%), and evening stress Tue 19:00 (100%). I'll prepare k6 script with randomized prompt sizes.
jena_csm: Data residency note: Orbit requires logs in eu-central and no cross-account metrics export. Hannah can you confirm log routing + retention?
hannah_sre: Confirmed. Logs -> eu-central S3, retention=120d, metrics tag customer:orbitlabs. Will add alert filters.
oliver_se: Fallback: prepare orbit-lite-q8 on cpu pool, auto-shift at >=4% errors for 5m. Also will validate tokenization parity for billing.
mike_ops: Rollout plan: canary 5% (10m), ramp 25% (15m), ramp 60% (20m), full 100% (rest). Rollback criteria: p99>1500ms OR errors>1% sustained 3m -> cut 50% to fallback and notify channel.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled "orbit-warmup" for 2026-04-02T13:00:00Z. Prechecks: infra=ok, model-compat=ok.
jena_csm: Great work. Owners: Oliver (quota+yaml), Hannah (alerts+logs), Mike (scripts+runbook). I'll send customer the schedule after YAML is in. Reconvene Wed if blockers.
